title: ヒヤシンスSの後に・勝者の影に

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Huff… I did it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And… I saw it—the brilliant sparkle of Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I thought their zeal for running is what made them precious. But now I believe the feelings they have toward racing…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Are much, much more serious and profound! I have no doubt that's why Doto dazzled the way she did!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I mustn't disturb that brilliance, but I do want to celebrate it!
Ngh… Sniffle…
Waaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? That voice… That's one of the other racers…

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I didn't make it… onto the scoreboard… Will I even make it… in the other graded races? I… I… Waaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I…

text_block_list.name: Defeated Trainer
text_block_list.text: Pull yourself together! Stand proud! You might have lost today, but didn't you give it your all?

text_block_list.name: Defeated Trainer
text_block_list.text: All we learned today is that those who finished ahead of us worked harder.

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Nnnngh…

text_block_list.name: Defeated Trainer
text_block_list.text: I know we haven't won a race yet, and it hurts to keep losing like this… but the Twinkle Series isn't over yet!

text_block_list.name: Defeated Trainer
text_block_list.text: Someday, you'll run in a G1 and you'll show everyone. Now, are you ready for the winning concert?

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're right! Okay, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I may have lost again, but this isn't over! There's always tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dash!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm so full of it…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I said I want to admire my oshis without disturbing them, but… it's impossible…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Each race has to have a winner, which means there have to be losers as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No one wants to see their oshis lose. Even a baby would know better than that, and yet, I…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ever since I decided to run in races myself, I've had an influence on the outcome… I can't say I'm just a spectator anymore…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My actions… affect other Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think today's race has sparked a change in Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I'd like to talk about the future. It's going to sound a bit out of character, but will you hear me out?
choice_data_list: Is it about our race schedule?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes. I want to run in a G1 race, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I think what I did to that other runner earlier was borderline unforgivable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Because of that, I want to run in a G1 race. I want to run and make her think, "Wow! Agnes Digital sure was strong!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And while I'm at it… I want to learn firsthand what level of effort the others are putting in to take on G1 races!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So, which race do you think I'm best suited for? Gimme your best recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I mentally collate which G1 races both admit classic-year runners and are a suitable distance for Agnes Digital…
choice_data_list: I think the NHK Mile Cup is the best fit.
I think the NHK Mile Cup is the best fit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The NHK Mile Cup! If that's your fantastic recommendation, then it must be right. I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: For her sake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A kind of winner's remorse has come over Agnes Digital, but it's given her the drive to push ahead.
